newsitem.title: LATVIA: Turnover falls on Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover falls on Latvian bourse.

text.p: Volume fell at the Latvian bourse on Tuesday, the Riga stock exchange said in a statement on Tuesday.
Overall market turnover was 26,500 lats compared with almost 65,000 lats on Thursday.
Market leader Unibank lost ground with its market price falling to 1.70 lats from 1.75. The value of its shares traded was just over 10,400 lats.
Riga Transport Fleet picked up steam and rose by 8.62 percent to 0.63 lats from 0.58 with turnover of over 12,500 lats.
